next_item_hypothesis: One demonstrated failure to test is first-token collision among a history anchor, its observed next item, and sampled negatives: frozen valid L1 positive hit rate directly measures whether item identity codes expose next-item affinity at the coarsest level. Train-only evidence contains directed edges and 0.9266197178950221 of directed pairs have no observed reverse event. A flat content quantizer may spend coarse code capacity on globally common directions and fail to place asymmetric related transitions into useful shared coarse regions. Test whether negative-curvature residual quantization improves coarse assignment while preserving item reconstruction. This is a hypothesis, not a causal conclusion.

math_definition.mechanism: Three-stage residual vector quantization in a fixed-radius Poincare-ball coordinate domain. Each level chooses from its own learned table of 256 32-dimensional code vectors. Only squared assignment distance D_c^2 differs between arms. Each item receives one global ordered SID (k1,k2,k3), independent of user and time.

frozen_geometry.scored_power: Squared distance only in both arms.
frozen_geometry.arcosh_numerics: For u>=1 let z=max(u-1,0); evaluate arcosh(u)=log1p(z+sqrt(z*(z+2))) in float64, with delta=1e-7 used only as the frozen roundoff tolerance when clamping a computed u below 1 back to 1 (no positive offset is added for valid u). Score the squared result.
frozen_geometry.domain_policy: Every vector entering a scored distance is projected into ||x||<=R by P_R(x)=x*min(1,R/||x||), with P_R(0)=0. This identical fixed region and projection applies in both arms. Do not use (1-epsilon)/sqrt(c): it is undefined at c=0, where the flat arm instead continues to use P_R with the same R.
frozen_geometry.flat_limit: As c->0, squared distance tends exactly to 4*||x-y||^2, unsquared distance tends to 2*||x-y||, and the exponential map tends to identity. The objective uses the squared power in both arms.
frozen_geometry.exponential_map: For c>0, Exp_0^c(v)=tanh(sqrt(c)*||v||)*v/(sqrt(c)*||v||), with value 0 at v=0; at c=0, Exp_0^0(v)=v. Map then project before any distance or assignment.

math_definition.latent_and_residual_assignment: For item i, content embedding e_i is mapped by the unchanged Stage2 encoder f_theta to h_i in R^32; set r_i^0=h_i. At each l=1,2,3 in order: map v_i^l=Exp_0^c(r_i^(l-1)); project x_i^l=P_R(v_i^l); assign k_i^l=argmin over j=1,...,256 of D_c^2(x_i^l,P_R(Exp_0^c(q_lj))), breaking exact ties by lowest index; let a_i^l=P_R(Exp_0^c(q_l,k_i^l)); then subtract in pre-map latent coordinates r_i^l=r_i^(l-1)-q_l,k_i^l. Thus operation order is map, project, assign, subtract; next residual is mapped and projected before scoring. The SID is (k_i^1,k_i^2,k_i^3); decoder reconstruction uses sum_l q_l,k_i^l.
math_definition.named_tensors_and_objective: Let I be train-split item indices; E in R^(|I| x d_e) be content embeddings; H=f_theta(E) in R^(|I| x 32); Q_l in R^(256 x 32); K_l in {1,...,256}^|I| be hard assignments; sg(.) stop gradients; xhat_i=g_phi(sum_{l=1}^3 Q_l[k_i^l,:]) in R^d_e. The single objective is L=(1/|I|) sum_{i in I} ||xhat_i-e_i||_2^2 + (beta/|I|) sum_{i in I} sum_{l=1}^3 ||sg(r_i^(l-1))-Q_l[k_i^l,:]||_2^2 + (gamma/|I|) sum_{i in I} sum_{l=1}^3 ||r_i^(l-1)-sg(Q_l[k_i^l,:])||_2^2. Norms sum over coordinates and then mean over items; all train items participate, so no empty-group case. beta and gamma are unchanged frozen Stage2 commitment coefficients, not tuned. Hard assignments are detached; reconstruction uses straight-through hard quantization for encoder gradients. Targets are current-forward hard assignments detached before loss computation, so no target-distribution circularity. The content reconstruction term is the anti-collapse mechanism: a constant code cannot reconstruct distinct content embeddings exactly.
math_definition.target_distributions: No learned or parameter-dependent target distribution is introduced; assignment is the deterministic nearest-code rule above.
math_definition.objective.anti_collapse: Content reconstruction is the explicit anti-collapse mechanism and enters as the first term of the single objective above. It retains item-specific content information; commitment terms alone cannot collapse the full objective to a lower value by assigning every item one code unless the content embeddings are identical.
math_definition.conditioning: Level 1 conditions on no earlier codes; level 2 conditions on exactly k1 via residual r^1; level 3 conditions on exactly (k1,k2) via residual r^2.

hyperbolic_necessity: Negative curvature is motivated as a geometry ablation, not established as necessary. Directed train-only transitions with no observed reverse event are compatible with asymmetric multi-scale organization; coarse-to-fine codes may represent this, and negative curvature is worth testing for reduced coarse crowding and improved first-token positive alignment. Direction and entropy do not prove hierarchy, curvature benefit, or causal improvement. Literature only establishes neighboring components, not this combined method.
euclidean_control: One implementation with c as parameter; flat arm is exact c->0 limit of the same squared-distance and exponential-map code path. Keep identical fixed projection, architecture, parameter count, initialization, optimizer, schedule, seeds, batch, epochs, codebook initialization and budget. No graph arm. All existing frozen Stage2 settings remain unchanged; no new training protocol or sweep.
effect_site: Stage2 assignment, codebook geometry and shared reconstruction/commitment objective at all three residual levels. Stage2 creates global item SIDs and does not rank or predict next items. Frozen downstream T5 Stage3 is the only next-item ranker.
real_trigger_measurement: Train-only manifest: directed_pairs=323633, transitions=339519, no_reverse_fraction=0.9266197178950221, mean_next_item_entropy_bits=4.844072338042215, population=train_only_longest_prefix_per_user. Trigger measurement is frozen validation first-token positive-hit / hard-L1 evaluation; validation is never training supervision.
training_only_inputs: Content embeddings and train-split item transitions are legal (CLAUDE.md rule 16); this candidate uses content embeddings only, not transition edges. No validation/test behavior, future events, prediction-time user context or batch-composition signal enters training, assignment, targets or codebook updates.
null_outcome_rule: If a seed-wise or aggregated change is undefined or non-finite (zero denominator, missing evaluation, or empty stratum), it is NULL. Any comparison containing a NULL seed is inconclusive, not passed or falsified; overall classification is NULL/inconclusive.

stage2_diagnostics.name: valid_l1_hard_er
stage2_diagnostics.direction: increase; strictly above frozen Resample reference
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Evaluate each preregistered seed on exactly the frozen 52855 validation pairs (one positive and ten negatives per anchor, seed 42, history[-1] -> target); aggregate by frozen Stage2 evaluation aggregation rule.

stage2_diagnostics.name: level2_distinct_prefixes
stage2_diagnostics.seed_rule: Count unique (k1,k2) over all items per seed; aggregate by frozen Stage2 evaluation aggregation rule.

stage3_behavioral_test.seed_rule: Evaluate unchanged downstream T5 Stage3 test_R@10 for preregistered matched seeds; compare paired per-seed candidate-minus-control and apply frozen aggregation rule. Test data is evaluation only.

classification.falsified_if: all registered comparisons are defined and finite, and at least one registered stage2 diagnostic or the stage3 behavioral test fails its registered minimum_effect
classification.passed_if: all registered comparisons are defined and finite, and every registered stage2 diagnostic and the stage3 behavioral test satisfies its registered minimum_effect
classification.mixed_if: all registered comparisons are defined and finite, and at least one registered threshold passes while another fails
